title: Cassette deck from audio controls
blurb: One <audio controls> element fills a canvas. CSS lays its native parts out as a grid, and the canvas draws them piece by piece as the keys, counter and tape slider of a cassette deck. The reels turn with currentTime, and the browser's own play glyph is copied onto the cassette label.
question: Can the native controls of an audio element be rearranged and drawn in pieces as another object, and stay the working controls?
result: Yes. The control panel accepts a CSS grid, a source rectangle draws one part at a time, and a final draw in an empty clip keeps taps on the native parts.
